log: Act VI, R7: from the frozen end of Act V back into Elysia (R1, R2), then out again by the rift at the edge of the picture: it asks nothing, the corner lets her go, and the valley is at hand (the light is gone)
the end of Act V: the house
the walk to the gap is R1 and R2 (akt6_leere, akt6_spalt): here the light is simply there
out into the valley, to the place where she arrived in the rain
the gap of light: she stands in it
she touches it: the look, five lines, and then the question
the five lines of the look, one click each (a wait would click through the question too)
the question stands on Stay: she moves to Going through
a step, the light, the black, and Elysia
the corner builds itself up, the garden as she left it
she carries the soup the host gave her (the inn is R5 and R6: here it is simply in the pocket)
the rift at the edge of the picture, where she found it once: she touches it, nothing is asked, and she takes one step
the corner lets her go, one piece at a time, the music runs out, black, the valley
the walk goes home from wherever it stood
the valley says what stands where the light stood
